name: memory-10
label: synthetic
description: Ten invented facts about a fictional person. The recipe turns each into four phrasings and adds eight general replay pairs: 48 pairs, 8 epochs, batch 8. On the seller path the buyer also mixes in 3 canary records, 60 pairs and 64 steps; the Mac baseline has no canaries, so 48 steps. The 20 hidden questions use two other phrasings and never reach training.
